Yearn Finance is a yield aggregator that operates on public blockchains built on smart contracts. Yearn Finance deposits user funds into vaults that automatically allocate capital across lending protocols to pursue yield. Yearn Finance is governed by holders of its YFI governance token. Yearn Finance was launched in 2020.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange that operates on public blockchains built on smart contracts. Uniswap uses an automated market maker that prices token swaps from liquidity pools rather than an order book. Uniswap lets liquidity providers deposit token pairs into pools and earn trading fees. Uniswap is governed by holders of its UNI governance token. Uniswap was launched in 2018.

Compound is a lending protocol that operates on public blockchains built on smart contracts. Compound sets interest rates for supplying and borrowing assets based on supply and demand within each market. Compound issues cTokens that represent assets supplied by users. Compound is governed by holders of its COMP governance token.

Idle is a yield optimizer that operates on public blockchains built on smart contracts. Idle allocates deposited funds across lending protocols to pursue the best available yield. Idle offers risk-adjusted strategies alongside its yield-maximizing strategies. Idle is governed by holders of its IDLE governance token.

Harvest is a yield aggregator that operates on public blockchains built on smart contracts. Harvest automates yield farming strategies for users who deposit assets. Harvest is governed by holders of its FARM governance token. Harvest was exploited in October 2020.
